label: One instruction at a time.
sub: Check them. Call 911. The dispatcher connects and sees your view.

label: Your hands push.
sub: On Specs, hand tracking counts each stroke. The ring pulses at 110 a minute, the beat comes from the chest, and it turns mint between 100 and 120.

label: Point at one person.
sub: Someone never asks the crowd. A chime and an arrow lead to the AED.

label: Swap. Pads. Stand clear.
sub: A rescuer swap at 2:00, pad placement on the chest, and a simulated shock from the AED.

label: You did not freeze.
sub: Compressions, time on pace, best streak and time to first push.
